---
title: "MSMS 2.6.2 released"
date: 2026-11-06
description: "A robustness release: MSMS no longer crashes on very large or unusual inputs, merges duplicate atoms instead of stopping, and computes all surface components in parallel."
image: ../../images/tools/msms.jpg
---

MSMS 2.6.2 is out for [Linux 64-bit](../../software/msms/download.qmd). It makes MSMS more robust:

- **Fewer crashes.** Inputs that used to crash MSMS, hang it or make it write corrupt files now
  work. These include surfaces with more than 2 million triangles, molecules of around 100,000
  atoms and more, very large and very small spheres, and more than 253 surface components with
  `-all_components` (the limit is now 65,535). Several recovery paths after numerical problems
  are also fixed.
- **Duplicate atoms.** Two atoms with the same centre no longer stop the run. MSMS keeps one of
  them, prints a warning and keeps the numbering of the input file.
- **Faster `-all_components`.** The search for buried components now runs in parallel. With 8
  threads it is about twice as fast.

**The output is unchanged.** For inputs that 2.6.1 handled, the `.vert`, `.face` and `.area` files
are byte-for-byte identical to those of the 2.6.1 source built with the same compiler.

The macOS and Windows downloads are still version 2.6.1.

**Update, November 12:** MSMS 2.6.2 is now also available
[for macOS and Windows](2026-11-12-msms-2-6-2-macos-windows.qmd).
